text:
```yaml
name: Build Windows Installer

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-windows-installer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup MSYS2
        uses: msys2/setup-msys2@v2
        with:
          msystem: MINGW64
          update: true
          install: >
            git
            base-devel
            mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python
            mingw-w64-x86_64-python-pip
            mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake
            mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja
            mingw-w64-x86_64-inno-setup

      - name: Setup Python
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Provision MSYS2 Environment
        run: |
          ./windows/provision-msys2.sh

      - name: Build OpenPLC Runtime
        run: |
          cd core
          mkdir build
          cd build
          cmake .. -G "Ninja"
          ninja
          cd ../..

      - name: Create Installer Directory Structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p installer/OpenPLC_Runtime
          cp -r core/bin/* installer/OpenPLC_Runtime/
          cp -r windows/* installer/
          cp -r start_openplc.sh installer/OpenPLC_Runtime/
          cp -r install.sh installer/OpenPLC_Runtime/

      - name: Compile Inno Setup Script
        run: |
          iscc windows/setup.iss

      - name: Upload Installer Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: openplc-runtime-installer
          path: installer/OpenPLC_Runtime_*.exe

      - name: Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        with:
          files: installer/OpenPLC_Runtime_*.exe
          draft: true
          generate_release_notes: true
```
